import numpy as np
import re

def clean(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()

    # --- age: ensure numeric, NaN preserved ---
    if 'age' in df.columns:
        df['age'] = pd.to_numeric(df['age'], errors='coerce').astype('float64')

    # --- income: '$1,200' / 'n/a' -> float ---
    if 'income' in df.columns:
        s = df['income'].astype('string').str.strip()
        s = s.str.replace(r'^\$', '', regex=True)
        s = s.str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        s = s.str.replace(r'(?i)^\s*(n/?a|none|null|-)?\s*$', np.nan, regex=True)
        df['income'] = pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')

    # --- city: strip, collapse whitespace, standardize case ---
    if 'city' in df.columns:
        s = df['city'].astype('string')
        s = s.str.replace(r'\s+', ' ', regex=True).str.strip()
        s = s.replace('', np.nan)
        s = s.str.title()
        df['city'] = s

    return df" }
